Name: SetDefaults
Description: Captures selected channel box attributes and their values, then restores them on build.

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Captures selected channel box attributes and their current values, storing them for rebuild.

How To Use:
  1. Create the block (no selection needed).
  2. Select objects in the viewport and highlight attributes in the Channel Box.
  3. Click Add to store those attribute values.
  4. Select entries and click Remove to delete them.
  5. On Build, those stored values will be set back on the controls.

Fields:
- RunAfterBuild: Check True to defer execution until after the full build finishes (recommended if attributes are built by later blocks).
- SetDefaultsList: List of node.attr = value entries.

Tips:
- Each entry is stored as node.attr = value.
- Supports any numeric attribute (float, int, bool, enum).
- You can add from multiple objects across multiple Add actions.
